## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-juan regional Buddhist record covering eminent monks of the Jiànzhōu 建州 region (modern north-central Fújiàn 福建), compiled by Yǒngjué Yuánxián as a local-history complement to his lamp-record continuation *Jìdēng lù* ([KR6q0038](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0038)). Title — "Record of Glorifying the Dharma in Jiànzhōu" — frames it as a regional commemoration.

**Abstract**

Yuánxián was abbot at Gǔshān Yǒngqiánsì 鼓山湧泉寺 in Fúzhōu and the central figure of seventeenth-century Cáodòng Chán in Fújiàn; the *Jiànzhōu hóng shì lù* gathers biographies and recorded sayings of Buddhist figures associated with the region, both Chán and other traditions. Useful as a primary source for late-Míng Fújiàn Buddhism.
